title: Recent advances in first-row transition metal clusters for photocatalytic water splitting
claim: Accessible hydroxyl-bearing coordination environments are proposed to aid water attack and O–O bond formation in an octanuclear copper-cubane catalyst.
explanation: In the reviewed Cu8 cluster containing two Cu4O4 fragments, ligand OH groups adjacent to five-coordinate Cu(II) sites were associated with its reported photocatalytic water-oxidation activity.
caveats: The proposed role of the OH groups is an interpretation of one catalyst, not an established general rule for Cu clusters.
